records.requirementOrFinding: *Fable 5. Status: DOCUMENT — the batch ladder for doc 31's painted game, superseding v2 (the Keen-era list; git history keeps it). Style law = **STYLE_PAINT_V1** (doc 31 §2; canonical constant in `docs/art/commission-z.mjs`). Pipeline laws carry unchanged: **style-key first, always** · **ONE image proven end-to-end (generate → import → QA → render in-game) before any volume batch** · manifests are allowlists · the only-present resolver keeps procedural fallbacks · **no batch for an unbuilt engine slot** · references = OUR OWN art only (CP-15). New paint QA gates (doc 31 §2): exact plate dims post-normalize · machine seam check on loopable strips · hard-edged sheet silhouettes (CP-9) · pixelation-regression scan (CP-10).*
